name: io.github.abasmartinc/apiempresas
title: SpainCompanyAPI: Spanish company data
description: Spanish company data: tax ID lookup, KYB, invoice recipient checks, directors, sanctions, tenders.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Searches Spanish companies (sociedades) by name or part of the name and returns up to 10 candidates with their tax ID (CIF), province and registry status. Use it when you do not have the CIF of a company; then call get_company with the chosen CIF. Sole traders (autónomos) are not included.

query.description: Company name or part of it

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Returns the basic public record of ONE Spanish company from its tax ID (CIF/NIF): legal name, status (active, dissolved, extinguished, in insolvency...), legal form with ISO 20275 code, LEI code, activity code (CNAE), province and incorporation date, plus tax_id_revocation if the Tax Agency has revoked or reinstated its tax ID. The status is derived from Mercantile Registry gazette (BORME) filings; it is not an official certificate. The street address and the directors are not included.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834. Spaces and hyphens are accepted.

tools.name: check_tax_id_revocation
tools.description: Checks whether the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) has revoked or reinstated the tax ID (NIF) of a company, as published in the official gazette (BOE). Returns status REVOKED or REHABILITATED with the date and the BOE link, or null if nothing has been published for that tax ID. A company with a revoked tax ID cannot operate with the Tax Agency and banks cannot process its payments. Works even when the company has no record in search_companies.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834. Spaces and hyphens are accepted.

tools.name: get_borme_stats
tools.description: Returns how many filings were published in the Mercantile Registry gazette (BORME) per month or per year, for all of Spain or one province, since 2009: incorporations, dissolutions, extinctions, insolvencies, capital increases and reductions, address changes and mergers. Use it for questions such as "how many companies were created in Valencia in 2025?". Dissolutions and insolvencies are not comparable between provinces; use extinctions to measure closures.

metrics.description: Comma-separated metrics: incorporations, dissolutions, extinctions, insolvencies, capital_increases, capital_reductions, address_changes, mergers. Default: all.

province.description: Province of the Mercantile Registry by name (e.g. MADRID, VALENCIA) or INE code (e.g. 28). Omit for all of Spain.

from.description: First month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY). Default: 11 months before "to".

to.description: Last month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY). Default: current month.
